«Война за трон» — это инновационная средневековая idle-игра на выживание, сочетающая стратегический игровой процесс с обилием подробностей, которые только и ждут, чтобы вы их исследовали.

Когда внезапный мятеж резко меняет судьбу целой династии и разжигает уровопролитную войну, бесчисленное количество человек теряют дома. В этом мире, разрываемом на части дезорганизацией общества, вторжениями мятежников, свирепствующими болезнями, а также монстрами, отчаянно жаждущими ресурсов, сложнейшая задача — это выживание. Как раз в эти смутные времена вы и становитесь губернатором, и именно от вас зависит, сможете ли вы провести своих людей через все опасности, продумывая внутренние и дипломатические стратегии, которые помогут вам вновь раздуть искру цивилизации.

[Ключевые функции]

top_apps.name: Space Base: Idle Tower Defense
top_apps.description_short: Build & defend your space base, upgrade turrets, survive endless waves. Idle TD.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Build the ultimate space base and hold the line against endless waves of enemies in Space Base — an idle tower defense game with deep turret upgrades and base progression. Place different turret types, unlock technologies and keep earning resources even while offline.

Key features:
- Build and upgrade your space base from scratch
- Multiple turret types: rapid‑fire, splash, freeze and sniper
- Deep tech tree and upgrade system
- AFK progress – earn resources while you are offline
- Epic bosses and special challenge waves
- Endless power growth and increasing difficulty

Plan your layout, combine turret types and find the most powerful builds. The smarter your defense, the further you survive. Download Space Base and protect the galaxy!

top_apps.name: Medieval Idle King
top_apps.description_short: Rule a chaotic medieval kingdom. Build, automate, and grow
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Medieval Idle King — an idle tycoon where you build your kingdom in a world of chaos.

Wars. Plagues. Rebellions.
And in the middle of it all — you.
A ruler with an empty treasury and massive ambition.

Start from nothing and turn your small settlement into a thriving empire in this idle clicker tycoon.

🏰 Build your kingdom
Develop your lands, construct buildings, and create an economy that generates income.

⚙️ Automate your earnings
Hire managers and earn even while you're offline.
A classic idle simulator experience with passive income.

💰 Grow your empire
Upgrade buildings, unlock new zones, and scale your profits.

🔥 Prestige and progress
Restart with powerful bonuses and grow faster each time.

🎮 Features:
- Idle clicker + tycoon gameplay
- Medieval setting
- Offline earnings
- Automation with managers
- Prestige system
- Build and expand your empire

Download now and claim your throne!

top_apps.description_short: Defend the castle, pop the balloons, and earn rewards!

top_apps.description_short: Enjoy familiar battles from the Pokémon series games in Pokémon Champions.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Enjoy Pokémon Battles on Mobile Devices!
Have fun battling Pokémon with ease on your mobile device!

■ Battle Pokémon with Ease!
In Pokémon Champions, you can enjoy Pokémon battles against Trainers from around the world.
You can play in Ranked Battles, featuring serious matches against players across the globe, or have fun in easygoing Casual Battles.

A flight over the frozen wasteland of Antarctica goes horribly wrong. The engines fail, your plane crashes into the icy wilderness, and you are left stranded in the most unforgiving environment on Earth. Just as the deadly cold sets in, your survivors spot an abandoned drill tower in the distance—your last chance for survival. Now, the only way out is down.

Welcome to Arctic Drill Tycoon, the ultimate hybrid of survival strategy and idle base-building. Beneath the permafrost lies a wealth of untapped resources. Build your station from the plane wreckage, fire up the furnace, and start drilling!

⛏️ DRILL TO SURVIVE
Command the massive central drill shaft as it pierces through the ice. Every layer you conquer unlocks new depths and rare materials. Upgrade your drill to increase mining speed and uncover what has been sleeping beneath the ice for millennia.
